# ValidateSpecs
## Rules
### Schema / filter
- `SchemaProvider.get()` (propagate SchemaNotFound/Validation). Keep only `scope === 'spec'` artifacts.
### Modes
- `specPath` (`workspace:capabilityPath`): parse → repo → `get` → validate one. Precedence over workspace.
- `workspace` only: `list(undefined, { includeMeta: true })` then each.
- Neither: all workspaces, same list Meta stamps.
### Per-spec local + cross-artifact
- Missing required → failure; missing optional → skip. Parse+evaluateRules when rules present. Reuse ValidateArtifacts cross-artifact engine for `scope:spec` rules; defer non-ready participants as non-failing notices.
### Result
- `ValidateSpecsResult`: `entries`, `totalSpecs`, `passed`, `failed`. Entry: `spec`, `passed`, `failures`, `warnings`.
### Format inference
- Infer via `inferFormat` if no format; no parser → skip silently.
### Metadata via GetSpecMetadata
- After artifact validation: `GetSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })` — NOT direct `readMetadataSnapshot` for pass/fail.
- Missing/stale cache OK if materialization succeeds. Materialization impossible → failure. Validate materialized `dependsOn` vs `readPersistedState().dependsOn` (or `[]`). Extraction mismatch → failure. `metadata-cache-write-failed` → warning.
### Optimization staleness
- Independent: stale `optimizedDescription`/`optimizedContext` → ValidationFailure even if other checks pass. No opts / all fresh → OK.
### ValidationResultCache
- lookup before full validate; upsert on miss. Hard hit skips revalidation. Pass list Meta stamps. Supply `schemaFingerprint` (spec validations + cross + dependsOn extraction presence) + `engineVersion`.
- Missing cache map entry → skip cache (tests/direct ctor only). Config factory MUST register per-workspace caches + GetSpecMetadata maps via `resolveValidateSpecsDeps`.
## Constraints
- ReadonlyMap of SpecRepositories — no mutation.
- Rules only from schema. Shared ValidationFailure/Warning with ValidateArtifacts.
- No own metadata freshness/gen/persist — only GetSpecMetadata.
